abstract: Within the last decade, progress in the management of testicular cancer has been remarkable. It has become a well-known fact that chemotherapy with or without excision of residual tumors can cure far-advanced disease. There are, as yet, unsolved problems such as the management of stage I disease, role of surgery in the treatment of stage III non-seminomatous testicular cancer and testicular damages by chemotherapy and so on. These problems will be discussed in this paper.
abstract_ja: 過去10年間で精巣がんの管理は著しく進歩した。化学療法は残存腫瘍の切除の有無にかかわらず、進行した病態を治癒させうることはよく知られた事実となった。病期Iの管理、非セミノーマ性精巣がん病期IIIにおける手術の役割、化学療法による精巣障害などの未解決の課題がある。本稿ではこれらの課題について論じる。
